Title: Purity contract catches ambient clock access
Summary: `[EnforcePure]` does not treat ambient time reads as pure. A direct read of `DateTime.Now` still produces `SP0002`.

Title: Invariant query proves a branch-local fact
Summary: At a specific program point, the symbolic CLI can report the merged invariant, prove reachability, and check whether the current facts imply another condition.

Title: Runtime hazard query proves guarded divide-by-zero
Summary: The runtime-hazard query surface can prove a concrete exception path from source guards without executing the method.

Title: Direct allocation sites under [ZeroAllocations]
Summary: `[ZeroAllocations]` reports each direct heap allocation site inside the annotated method-like body instead of collapsing everything into one method-level warning.

Title: Capability query for console I/O
Summary: The symbolic CLI can classify proven side-effect capability categories at a point inside a method, including derived umbrella categories such as `IO`.

Title: Conservative method complexity query
Summary: The complexity query surface reports the best proven asymptotic cost for the containing method-like body and explains the structural drivers that established it.
